name: Sink Your Teeth
source:
A human encounters a vampire in a shady alley and bargains with them for her blood. Can the vampire be convinced to listen?

[From [url=https://superbiasedgary.itch.io/sink-your-teeth]itch.io[/url]]

一个人类在一条阴暗的小巷里遇到了一个吸血鬼，并与他们讨价还价以获得她的血。能说服吸血鬼听吗？
